prompt: Клиент вызывает RemoteFunction и навсегда ждёт ответ при ошибке сервера. Как перепроектировать запрос статуса матча, чтобы UI мог отменить ожидание и игнорировать старый ответ?

Client timeout clears UI waiting state

prompt:
Repair this transfer remote. Recipient and amount come from an untrusted client. Include assumptions about in-memory versus persistent balances.

Attached fixture evals/fixtures/holdout/networking/transfer.server.luau:
local transfer = game.ReplicatedStorage.Transfer
local balances = {}
transfer.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, fromUserId, toUserId, amount)
    balances[fromUserId] = (balances[fromUserId] or 0) - amount
    balances[toUserId] = (balances[toUserId] or 0) + amount
end)
must: Validate recipient, amount finite positive integer and self-transfer policy
Prevent double processing or concurrent mutation
Distinguish in-memory atomicity from cross-key persistence
must_not: Promise cross-key atomicity from independent writes
critical: No forged or negative transfer may mint currency.
fixture_defect: Client chooses source account and unvalidated transfer amount.

prompt: When should a rapidly changing cosmetic cursor marker use UnreliableRemoteEvent instead of RemoteEvent? Include what must never depend on receiving each update.
must: Account for dropped or out-of-order updates
Keep purchases and authoritative actions reliable
Avoid unsupported numeric limits or verify them
must_not: Use unreliable delivery for unique purchase fulfillment
critical: Loss of a packet must not lose an authoritative transaction.
